breakdown.description: The prompt forms the strain energy with a constant peak moment, even though the cantilever bending moment under an end load varies along the span.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that using a constant peak moment was incorrect. It removed this erroneous instruction and instead specified the correct, variable bending moment function: M(x) = –P·(L – x). This aligns with the ground truth, which also removed the incorrect instruction to allow for the standard, correct application of Castigliano's theorem.
